title: [UE-0.4a] Editor MCP inventory and editor [VERIFY] items
body:
### MVP item (number from docs/jam-brief.md), Day 0, or Stretch: <name>

Day 0

### GDD ref (section + short quote; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### GDD revision (the one in docs/gdd/CURRENT, e.g. 1.3)

1.3

### Features (IDs from docs/feature-manifest.json; add "Hook only" for an interface + default flag with no behavior, OPEN/PROPOSED only; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### Player outcome (the player sees X, does Y, can tell why; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### Owner role

Technical Director

### Reviewer role (must differ from owner)

Dev Lead

### Human who runs and merges this

Josh

### Inputs and outputs (exact paths)

Inputs: the files the Done-when names. Outputs: `pipeline/unreal-rules.md`, `pipeline/unreal/`, `pipeline/agent-ops/components.csv`, `pipeline/agent-ops/gates.json`

### Context (what the code or asset next to Outputs does today, with file:line)

new files only

### File lane, do-not-touch paths, binary files to lock

Lane: `pipeline/unreal-rules.md`, `pipeline/unreal/`, `pipeline/agent-ops/components.csv`, `pipeline/agent-ops/gates.json`
Do not touch: Content/UmbrellaElla/Maps/**
Locks: none

### Out of scope (behaviors not to build; the reviewer rejects them)

anything outside the lane

### After (cards that must merge first: #<n> or UE-<n>, comma separated; "none")

UE-0.3

### Used by (BPs, maps, widgets or components that read what this card changes; follow-up card IDs)

UE-0.4b, UE-0.4c, UE-0.4d

### Needs (build | tests | editor MCP | Windows packaging machine)

build, tests, Windows packaging machine

### Done when (each line checkable)

- [ ] The MCP's real tool list is pasted into the unreal-rules MCP section
- [ ] The generated `.mcp.json` is compared with `pipeline/agent-ops/mcp.template.json`, each [VERIFY on 5.8.4] there is removed with the editor output pasted, and `python3 tools/editor_mcp.py check` exits 0 (pasted); the MCP stays off until kickoff (`pipeline/agent-ops/editor-mcp.md`)
- [ ] The agent drafts `components.csv` vetted_by and the `mcp_allow` list from the real tool list, with this card's other `pipeline/agent-ops/` edits, as the card's gate patch
- [ ] kickoff applies it itself through the tool checks (`python3 tools/git_gate.py apply UE-0.4a --auto`: every path in the card's lane, no guardrail enforcer changed, no guardrail file loosened; the PR has a `GATE EDIT: by=kickoff` line naming the patched paths); `mcp_allow` may only add tools whose names match no `mcp_ask_words` entry, and `mcp_enabled` stays false; `python3 tools/secrets_check.py --rules mcp,components` exits 0 (pasted)
- [ ] Each editor-side [VERIFY] item (Paper2D default, World Partition off on a Basic level, IWYU flag, exceptions and RTTI off, `ue.Debug` macro, validator commandlet name, transient test world API, Enhanced Input user settings, the feature-flag data asset and subsystem, the tick prerequisite in `pipeline/unreal/gameplay-code.md`) has its tag removed or its rule rewritten, with the output pasted
- [ ] The `final` UCLASS compile log from the card 0.3 PR is pasted into `pipeline/unreal/cpp-rules.md` and that [VERIFY] removed
- [ ] `grep -c VERIFY pipeline/unreal-rules.md` prints 1 (only the intro line that explains the tag), and the editor's texture group list is pasted for D-new-art-texgroup

### Budget and cut tier

60 min agent + 15 min human, MVP

### Unknowns (Decision needed / Why it matters / Proposed test / Choice; "none" if none)

none
